create_Dim_named_dimension: create a Dim object with a name and optional size for named dimension tracking
set_Dim_size: set the size property of a Dim instance to bind it to a specific dimension size
check_Dim_is_bound: check if a Dim instance is bound by calling its is_bound property
use_dims_helper: use the dims helper function to auto-generate Dim objects from unpacked variable names
use_dim_set: use _dim_set to convert positional arguments and Dim objects into a tuple of Dims
